name: Process: Run the brief's team slot per period, and record which item ran
text_content:
P20 and row 119. Every brief carries the slot after the readiness block: one item from the list in its priority, spoken by the owner of the room or the room designation, ending at the scene trigger, dropped whole on a compressed window (one on which the readiness block ran in its thirty-second form), item 1 alone at the early morning's window brief, no second slot where periods run back to back. The reviewing lead chooses the capture read as process; the room's owner speaks it. The brief's record on the OS surface marks which item ran or that the slot was dropped, and the reset counts briefs with a slot against briefs without; a slot dropped on most briefs of a quarter is read as sequence corruption on the window, never as a lead's. The pass owner's line and the kitchen's brief are chef-gated. Extends 86akh6779, 86akhcz2y, and 86akhcz4g by reference. High.

Filed by Session 10 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmj2u. Reasoning lives on the S10 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
